jobs.prompt: Item E7: swarm ship refuses forever on a project (atlas-seafloor) because every swarm command rewrites coordination/HANDOFF.md, so the working tree is never clean. In tools/ship.mjs find the clean-tree check (the place that reads git status porcelain or a dirty-tree helper and refuses). Make that check ignore swarm-generated files: coordination/HANDOFF.md, coordination/HANDOFF.previous.md, coordination/HANDOFF.previous-2.md, TASK.md, coordination/TASK.md, build-plan.md, coordination/build-plan.md and docs/state/usage-ledger.md (the same set the hand-build guard calls routing files, plus the ledger); any other dirty or untracked file still refuses, and the refusal message lists the files that blocked it. Keep behavior otherwise. Add tests in tests/ship-clean-tree.test.mjs (node:test, strict assert, temporary git repositories using the real clean-tree function or the smallest exported function that holds the check; export a small helper dirtyBlockers(porcelainLines) from tools/ship.mjs if needed): a tree dirty only with those files passes; one other modified file refuses and is named; an untracked source file refuses; a mix names only the blocking files; a rename involving a generated file is handled; empty status passes. Write only tools/ship.mjs and tests/ship-clean-tree.test.mjs.
